'''Barry C. Arnold''' (born December 6, 1939)<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cardinal.lib.iastate.edu/repositories/2/resources/1115|title=Barry Arnold papers|work=[[Iowa State University]]|access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref> is a British-born American [[statistician]]. He was a [[distinguished professor]] in the department of [[statistics]] at the [[University of California, Riverside]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://profiles.ucr.edu/app/home/profile/barnold|title=Barry C Arnold|work=[[University of California, Riverside]]|access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref>

In 2001, Arnold was named a [[Fellow of the American Association for the Advancement of Science|fellow]] of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows/historic?field_last_name_value=All&field_address_city=All&field_address_when_elected_administrative_area=All&field_address_when_elected_country_code=All&field_year_elected=&field_primary_aaas_section=All&field_status_value=All&field_year_status_changed_value=&name_combine=barry%20&field_institutional_affiliation_value=|title=Historic Fellows|work=[[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]|access-date=August 28, 2026}}</ref>
